scientific_integrity: Analytical finite-dimensional proof and independently reconstructed finite tests; prior star/complete limit and general spectral pinching are credited, not claimed as discoveries.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge complete bipartite reversal for every \(2\le m<n\), with fixed \(\gamma>0\); the weighted-graph statement concerns only the first-order slope; uniqueness of switching is not asserted.
title: Degree-to-part-size reversal under intrinsic dephasing on complete bipartite quantum networks
